territorial_scope.description: Applies within the State of Georgia by amending the Official Code of Georgia Annotated and creating a Georgia state commission.

evidence.quote: BE IT ENACTED BY THE GENERAL ASSEMBLY OF GEORGIA:

summary.short: Suspends new sales and use tax exemption certificates for high-technology data center equipment from July 1, 2024 to June 30, 2026, with a contract exception; revises the new quality jobs definition; creates a 14-member Special Commission on Data Center Energy Planning, abolished June 30, 2026.
summary.long: As passed by both chambers, the bill amends Code Section 48-8-3 so the commissioner must suspend new sales and use tax exemption certificates under paragraph (68.1) from July 1, 2024 to June 30, 2026, unless a later Act based on the commission's findings provides otherwise. An exception covers high-technology data center customers under ongoing contracts entered before July 1, 2024, with data centers that applied for certificates before that date. The bill also revises the 'new quality jobs' definition: located in Georgia, a regular work week of 30 hours or more, not a job that is or was already located in Georgia regardless of employer, and pay at or above 150 percent of the county average wage. It creates a 14-member Special Commission on Data Center Energy Planning to review grid and energy supply, recommend data center locations and grid expansion, examine trends including artificial intelligence, survey corporate employers and propose legislation. The commission reports in writing within three months after its last meeting, may hold hearings and obtain agency information, and is abolished and its article repealed on June 30, 2026. No penalties are stated; the Act takes effect on approval or on becoming law without signature and repeals conflicting laws.

notes: The document is the text as passed by both chambers ("AS PASSED HOUSE AND SENATE"); it contains no enactment or veto record. The vetoed/dead status comes from registry metadata only. The Section 1 amendment text does not show underlining or strike-through, so the new wording cannot be separated from restated text. The new quality jobs clause reads "shall have the same meaning as provided in ... 48-7-40.17 means employment", a drafting inconsistency in the text itself. The Section 1 suspension period ends June 30, 2026, the same date on which Section 2's commission article stands repealed (Code Section 50-7-124, an automatic sunset of the article the act creates, not a repeal of other law).
